steps.say: Treat-to-target in rheumatoid arthritis is driven by composite scores. DAS28 below two point six is recorded as remission. Low activity up to three point two is accepted between flares. Joints with labs and global health are counted together.
steps.tx: **DAS28** counts 28 joints with ESR or CRP and patient global: below **2.6** is remission, **3.2** or less is low activity. **CDAI** drops labs entirely and still calls remission at **2.8** or less with low activity at **10.0** or less. This figure is the display of the EULAR response bands. Treat-to-target escalates therapy until low activity or remission holds.

vis.alt: A 2D plot showing EULAR response categories based on DAS28 end score and change from baseline, with regions for good, moderate, and no response.
vis.caption: EULAR response bands for DAS28: end score with change decides good, moderate, or no response. Treat-to-target aims for remission. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: SDAI is the simplified stringent bedside score. Joint counts with two globals and CRP are added on paper. Three point three or less is recorded as remission. Boolean two point zero agreement is found at that bar.
steps.tx: **SDAI** sums 28 tender with swollen joints, patient and physician globals on **0 to 10 cm** scales, and CRP: **3.3** or less is stringent remission matching **Boolean 2.0**. No calculator and no computer are needed, so the score works at every bedside. CDAI with SDAI together cover clinics with and without same-day labs.

steps.say: Trial responses are standardized as ACR twenty, fifty, and seventy. Twenty percent joint improvement with three of five core items is required for each rung. Higher rungs are achieved by fewer patients. All three rungs are reported together. ACR20 with ACR50 responses are counted before ACR70 celebration.
steps.tx: **ACR20**, **ACR50**, and **ACR70** demand **20 percent**, **50 percent**, or **70 percent** gains in tender with swollen counts, plus matching gains in 3 of 5 core items: patient global, physician global, pain, **HAQ-DI**, and reactants. Trials report all three rungs, because twenty is common while seventy is rare. Placebo responses are subtracted before celebration.

steps.say: Function is measured by the health assessment HAQ-DI across daily tasks. Twenty activities in eight categories are scored from zero to three. Zero point two two change is accepted as meaningful improvement. Function with inflammation is tracked together.
steps.tx: **HAQ-DI** grades disability over **20 tasks** in **8 life areas**, dressing through walking, scored **0 to 3**; a shift of **0.22** marks the minimal important difference. Function, not just swelling, decides escalation, and aids with joint replacement reset the scale. Every trial with every clinic records it.

steps.say: Axial spondyloarthritis activity is scored by BASDAI with ASDAS. Four or more on the zero to ten BASDAI is recorded as active disease. ASDAS below one point three is recorded as inactive. Higher bands are matched to stronger therapy.
steps.tx: **BASDAI** averages six 0-to-10 symptom scores, with **4 or more** marking active axial disease. **ASDAS** adds CRP or ESR: below **1.3** is inactive, **1.3 to below 2.1** moderate, **2.1 to 3.5** or less high, above **3.5** very high. NSAID failure at high bands earns biologics, and both scores are rechecked at every visit.

steps.say: Systemic lupus activity is scored by SLEDAI-2K over thirty days. Twenty-four weighted items are summed across organs. Six or more is recorded as active disease needing change. Four or less is required for low activity state.
steps.tx: **SLEDAI-2K** sums **24 weighted** organ items over the past **30 days**; **6 or more** means active lupus needing therapy change, while **4 or less** with low steroids and stable serology defines **LLDAS**, Lupus Low Disease Activity State. Serology alone never scores, and damage never counts as activity.

steps.say: Systemic necrotizing vasculitis activity is separated from damage by BVAS with VDI. Sixty-four items across nine systems are checked for new or worse disease. Old burnt-out scars are scored as damage instead. Both scores are recorded at every visit.
steps.tx: **BVAS version 3** grades **64 items** across **nine** organ systems as new, worse, or persistent, marking active **necrotizing vasculitis**. Chronic scars score zero here and move to the **VDI** damage index instead. Activity earns immunosuppression while damage earns rehabilitation, and mixing the two mistreats both.

steps.say: Psoriatic arthritis is judged by five of seven minimal disease items. One or fewer tender with swollen joints and small skin scores are required. Pain with global and function bars are all set low. Five fulfilled items are celebrated as victory.
steps.tx: **MDA** in psoriatic arthritis needs 5 of 7: swollen joints **1 or less**, tender joints **1 or less**, **PASI 1 or less** or skin **3 percent** or less, pain **15 mm** or less, global **20 mm** or less, **HAQ-DI 0.5** or less, and entheseal points **1 or less**. Five bars cleared is the treat-to-target win, rechecked at every visit like every score above.
